comparison.objective: Transfer a datum height with a communicating-vessel water level and mark a distant post; the candidate commissions an adjustable axis damper through repeated impact trials.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires coordinated handling of a liquid reservoir, hose end, and marker without spilling. Candidate requires hex-key insertion, setscrew torque, collar rotation, counterholding, and guarded cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a mark within 1.5 mm, tools returned, and no more than 1 mL spilled. Candidate requires two safe repeatable stops within a 12 mm stroke after physical unlock-adjust-relock operations.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities and outcomes differ materially; bimanual stabilization and visual adjustment are only generic shared primitives. Candidate rubric omits numeric limits for collar drift, excessive rebound, and overload, but those omissions do not make this unrelated datum-transfer task a plausible duplicate.
